commands: for f in skills/docs-release-notes/SKILL.md skills/docs-sync-external/SKILL.md skills/docs-sync-internal/SKILL.md; do printf '%s  ' "$f"; python3 -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()).hexdigest())" "$f"; done
for f in docs-bootstrap-external docs-bootstrap-internal docs-verify docs; do echo "=== $f ==="; grep -n "anchor-resolution" skills/$f/SKILL.md; done

for f in skills/review/SKILL.md skills/pr-description/SKILL.md skills/docs-bootstrap-external/SKILL.md skills/docs-bootstrap-internal/SKILL.md skills/docs-verify/SKILL.md skills/docs/SKILL.md skills/implement/SKILL.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; grep -n "anchor-resolution" "$f"; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
